scene: The crystal goggles shimmer, revealing secret rooftop transit portals.
picture: Side view along a glowing observation deck floor outside the shop. On the far left, a vine-wrapped wooden rope-bridge lift swings gently. Left of centre, the boy wears glittering crystal goggles, holding his skateboard. In the centre right sits a docked paddle steamer. On the far right, a coiled trampoline lift awaits.
shown: a dangling vine-covered wooden rope-bridge lift platform on the far left
a miniature red rooftop paddle steamer docked in a canal centre right
a giant glowing trampoline lift spring bouncing gently on the far right
